propositions: reconcile-bridge-canary.yml contains ~200 lines of untestable YAML logic (staleness classification, two alert-ticket state machines) that should be migrated to Python for linting and unit testing

alert lifecycle steps (find/open/comment/close) for heartbeat and binding-drift have error-handling disposition that must be preserved: find-operations fail-soft, write-operations fail-loud, fsck exit-1-with-JSON treated as drift-signal not error
CAS push loops (reconcile-bridge.yml commit-back and canary flush) remain in YAML byte-identical and are tested verbatim, creating a documented exception per d37e raw-git-write lint guard

extracted scripts/canary_bridge.py subcommands must emit GITHUB_OUTPUT keys, respect DRY_RUN env flag with defense-in-depth re-check, and preserve exact classification outputs (stale, last_run_ago, status_msg)
anti-rot test pins the canary wiring and confirms no new logic-bearing run-blocks reappear; class guard assertion re-points from YAML to module runtime behavior
